name: duplicate defaults decision rejected
policy_yaml:
version: 1
defaults:
  decision: deny
  decision: allow

name: duplicate nested allow rejected
policy_yaml:
version: 1
defaults:
  decision: deny
environments:
  production:
    databases:
      main:
        allow:
          - operations: [select]
        allow:
          - operations: [drop]

name: duplicate rule operations rejected
policy_yaml:
version: 1
defaults:
  decision: deny
environments:
  production:
    databases:
      main:
        allow:
          - operations: [select]
            operations: [drop]

name: duplicate carries line and column
policy_yaml:

version: 1
defaults:
  decision: deny
  require_limit: off

version: 1
defaults:
  decision: deny
  require_limit: TRUE
